title: Select one value
summary: A selector chooses the store value a component needs.

blocks.text: A selector chooses the store value a component needs. Selecting a small value helps avoid updates from unrelated changes.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.
